payload.claim: Each of the four witnesses is written to drive a very large number of distinct sub-scenarios inside a single test function (criterion 1's witness alone drives both entry forms, ordering, three near-miss subjects, two near-miss paths, an import, an attribute read, a no-trailing-newline file, a Markdown reader, an undecodable file, and a missing sha). This matches the repository's existing style (e.g. test_consumes.py's combined unreadable-entries test), so it is not a defect in the spec, but a reviewer auditing the eventual test file will need to read one long function carefully to confirm every described branch is actually exercised rather than merely asserted to exist.
